_about: The words a page prints for a stored value. One file, read by the templates and by scripts/import/check_rendered_fields.php, so the page and the check cannot disagree about wording (Nathan, 7 October 2026: 'settle on one phrase'). Every value has a phrase and every phrase is printed: a blank would leave a reader unable to tell a value from a gap ('not elected' against 'not yet recorded').

howEnded.lines-moved: the lines moved; the district no longer held the valley
howEnded.unknown: how it ended is not recorded

selectionMethod.rotated: chosen by the board in rotation
selectionMethod.sole-candidate: the sole candidate; no election held

educationOutcome.unknown: whether he or she graduated is not recorded
